metadata.title: Sheth et al. (2012) Science — Distal Hox/Gli3 Dose Modulation of Turing Wavelength & Polydactyly Reference Dataset

sources.citation: Sheth R, Marcon L, Bastida MF, Junco M, Quintana L, Dahn R, Kmita M, Sharpe J, Ros MA (2012). Hox genes regulate digit patterning by controlling the wavelength of a Turing-type mechanism. Science 338(6113):1476-1480.

vertebrate_hexadactyl_autopod.species: Homo sapiens / vertebrate postaxial hexadactylous autopod AP radiograph (6 metacarpals and phalangeal digit rays on a fan-shaped distal hand plate)
vertebrate_hexadactyl_autopod.author: Dr.icken / Wikimedia Commons

sheth_2012_hox_turing_kinetics.section: Sheth et al. (2012) Science 338:1476-1480 Figs. 1-4 & Supplementary Materials Eqs. (S1)-(S6)

governing_pde.u_eq: du/dt = f_u(H) * u + f_v * v - u^3 + D_u * Lap(u)
governing_pde.v_eq: dv/dt = g_u(H) * u + g_v * v + D_v * Lap(v)
governing_pde.boundary_condition: Zero-flux Neumann n . grad(u) = n . grad(v) = 0 on distal fan-shaped autopod domain
